name: gelu_and_mul
description: Fused gated exact GELU. Splits hidden_states of shape [..., 2*d] into x1 = hidden_states[..., :d] and x3 = hidden_states[..., d:], computes gelu_exact(x1.float()) * x3.float() in float32, and casts the result back to the input dtype. The reference supports leading dimensions; the Triton candidate requires a 2-D input of shape [batch, 2*d] but honors arbitrary row and column strides of that input (only the last dimension is split), and returns a newly allocated contiguous tensor of shape [batch, d] on the input device without mutating or aliasing the input. Current tests exercise bfloat16 2-D inputs with d 16..8192.
